rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Files uploaded via public career page apply form are saved to /app/uploads, but the resume download endpoints (/api/applications/{app_id}/resume and /api/candidates/{candidate_id}/resume) were only checking UPLOAD_DIR which points to /app/backend/uploads
reproduction_steps: 1. Apply to a job via public career page (careers.html)
3. Login as employer and view applicant
4. Click Download button - returns 404 'Resume file not found'
5. The endpoint was looking in /app/backend/uploads but file was in /app/uploads
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Updated both download endpoints to check /app/uploads first, then /app/backend/uploads as fallback
